title: libpod: accept explicit graph driver when DB has none recorded
body:
When storage.conf does not set a graph driver, the database config row is written with an empty driver, because c/storage only selects one when the store is opened.  ValidateDBConfig then substitutes an empty database value with the c/storage default, which is empty as well.  Once the database contained any container, pod or volume, explicitly requesting the driver that is in use (e.g. --storage-driver overlay) failed with:

  database graph driver "" does not match our graph driver "overlay"

If neither the database nor the default names a driver there is nothing to compare against, so use the requested driver instead of rejecting it. A driver that differs from a recorded, non-empty one is still an error.

Add a unit test for both cases.

Fixes: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/30282
